headline: 10 Dead in Cox's Bazar hillslide as heavy rains lash Bangladesh
summary: The death toll from landslides in Cox's Bazar has risen to 10. Heavy monsoon rains continue to batter the region, causing further devastation and displacement.
details: At least 10 people have been killed in Cox's Bazar due to landslides triggered by incessant monsoon rains. Rescue operations are underway, but the challenging terrain and ongoing rainfall are hampering efforts.
The affected areas are primarily hilly regions where many residents live in vulnerable settlements. Authorities are urging people in low-lying and landslide-prone zones to evacuate to safer shelters.

The Meteorological Department has forecast more heavy rainfall across the country in the coming days, raising concerns about further landslides and flooding, particularly in the southeastern districts.
Local administration is providing aid and support to the affected families, including temporary shelter and essential supplies. The full extent of the damage is still being assessed.

headline: 67,000 customers left in dark after fire at rural electricity substation
summary: A massive power outage has affected thousands of residents following a fire incident at a Palli Bidyut substation.
details: A fire broke out at a rural electricity substation, causing a widespread power outage that has left approximately 67,000 customers without electricity.
The incident has plunged large areas into darkness, disrupting daily activities and essential services for thousands of residents.
Emergency response teams and electricity officials are working to address the cause of the fire and restore power to the affected regions.
Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the fire to determine if it was due to a technical fault or other external factors.
